lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Guys, I need more energy! Someone talk to them! I'm busy bombing!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Put down your trash food, turn off your shit television, and get on with it!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Matter for once in your meaningless, little, insignificant, worthless human lives!

lines.text: You know what? Screw this. I'm taking my energy back.

lines.text: Vegeta, stop Vegeta-ing! You're making it worse!
